# Lab 4.10: Approximate & Sketch Functions

## What We Are Going to Do
Compare exact and approximate distinct counts for cost and accuracy, and use HyperLogLog++ sketches that can be merged later.

## Steps

1. **[SQL] Exact vs approximate.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT repository_url) AS exact_repos
FROM `bigquery-public-data.samples.github_timeline`;

SELECT APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT(repository_url) AS approx_repos
FROM `bigquery-public-data.samples.github_timeline`;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Compare **Slot time** and **Elapsed time**. The difference is usually under 1%.

2. **[SQL] Store daily sketches.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE TABLE lab04.daily_user_sketch AS
SELECT DATE(created_at) AS day, HLL_COUNT.INIT(user_id) AS users_sketch
FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.orders`
GROUP BY day;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[SQL] Merge sketches for any period.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC(day, MONTH) AS month,
  HLL_COUNT.MERGE(users_sketch) AS monthly_unique_users
FROM lab04.daily_user_sketch
GROUP BY month ORDER BY month DESC LIMIT 6;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   You cannot add daily distinct counts to get a monthly count. Sketches can be merged correctly.

5. **[CLI] Compare slot time from job metadata.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq query --use_legacy_sql=false \
'SELECT LEFT(query, 40) AS q, total_slot_ms FROM `region-us`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.JOBS_BY_USER
 WHERE creation_time &gt; TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AND query LIKE "%github_timeline%"'</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Approximate count | Within about 1%, less slot time |
| HLL sketches | Stored per day |
| Merge | Correct monthly unique users |
| `APPROX_QUANTILES` | Fast percentiles |
